about_short_description.short_description: Appwrite is a secure end-to-end BaaS for Web, Mobile, and Flutter developers

product.name: Auth
product.description: A user authentication service supporting multiple login methods including Email/Password, SMS, OAuth, Anonymous, and Magic URLs.

product.name: Databases
product.description: A scalable database service for storing and managing application and user data.

product.name: Storage
product.description: A file storage service offering secure file storage with compression, encryption, and image transformation capabilities.

product.name: Functions
product.description: A serverless functions platform supporting deployment and scaling in multiple runtimes and languages.

product.name: Messaging
product.description: A messaging service that supports sending and scheduling emails, SMS, and push notifications across multiple channels.

product.name: Realtime
product.description: An API service that enables subscription and reaction to Appwrite events in real time.
